name: Stubble
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of stubble to represent the frailty and transience of the wicked. Like stubble before the wind or fire, the ungodly are portrayed as easily consumed and scattered because of their rejection of God's law and word, as seen in Exodus 15:7 and Isaiah 5:24. This metaphor emphasizes their lack of rootedness and ultimate destruction, contrasting with the stability and righteousness God establishes, as reflected in Isaiah 40:24 and Isaiah 41:2.
